meaning:
παρά-κειμαι
[in LXX: Jdt.3.2-3, Sir.30:18 34:16, Dan LXX Bel 1:14, 2,3 Mac.5* ;]
to lie beside, be near, be present: Rom.7:18, 21.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don’t find it doing that which is good.
